question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Walden, Bob gets The Trial, Claire gets Candide, Dave gets Ivanhoe, Eve gets Dracula, Fred gets Middlemarch, and Gertrude gets Hamlet.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Eve and Claire swap books. Then, Dave and Eve swap books. Then, Alice and Dave swap books. Then, Claire and Eve swap books. Then, Fred and Alice swap books. Then, Gertrude and Claire swap books. Finally, Gertrude and Fred swap books. At the end of the semester, Bob has
Options:
(A) Walden
(B) The Trial
(C) Candide
(D) Ivanhoe
(E) Dracula
(F) Middlemarch
(G) Hamlet
solution:
Book order in every row: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve | Fred | Gertrude
Initial: Walden | The Trial | Candide | Ivanhoe | Dracula | Middlemarch | Hamlet
1. Eve ↔ Claire: Walden | The Trial | Dracula | Ivanhoe | Candide | Middlemarch | Hamlet
2. Dave ↔ Eve: Walden | The Trial | Dracula | Candide | Ivanhoe | Middlemarch | Hamlet
3. Alice ↔ Dave: Candide | The Trial | Dracula | Walden | Ivanhoe | Middlemarch | Hamlet
4. Claire ↔ Eve: Candide | The Trial | Ivanhoe | Walden | Dracula | Middlemarch | Hamlet
5. Fred ↔ Alice: Middlemarch | The Trial | Ivanhoe | Walden | Dracula | Candide | Hamlet
6. Gertrude ↔ Claire: Middlemarch | The Trial | Hamlet | Walden | Dracula | Candide | Ivanhoe
7. Gertrude ↔ Fred: Middlemarch | The Trial | Hamlet | Walden | Dracula | Ivanhoe | Candide
Bob has The Trial, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
